Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0/1 flag: 1 while you stand in a realm beyond the forest, 0 everywhere else.

//InRealm: Feature 30 (plan section 30, W0-18 section 2.5): the realm PRESENCE FLAG. Nothing writes it: the BaseValue stays 0, and a realm's CardType 8 location card (hwlocfaerierealm) adds +1 as a PassiveStatEffects value modifier, which the game applies only while that card is in the player's environment and cancels when the player leaves by any way. So it reads 1 exactly while the player stands in a realm. Read by the four raid rolls (hw_tgr_blackbear, hw_tgr_eagle, hw_tgr_heron, hw_tgr_wolverine), each gated on it at {0,0} by a StatChangeTrigger entry.
